components.name: SearchButton
components.doc: The one search affordance an app puts in its chrome: an icon button that opens the platform search over the whole app. It never draws a field, and a window bar that searches for the window takes its place.

components.name: ActivityTimeline
components.doc: The history of a document, grouped: runs of typing fold into one band that opens to its changes, each day's changes sit under the day's heading, and a change's menu offers reverting it.

props.name: fill
props.doc: The pane takes the height its parent gives it and scrolls inside, rather than being as tall as its rows inside another scroll.

props.name: newest_first
props.doc: Whether it lists changes newest first.

props.name: day_headings
props.doc: Whether the pane shows the calendar's Today/Yesterday/This week headings.

props.name: people_filters
props.doc: Whether it offers every person and agent in the history as a filter.

slots.name: entries
slots.doc: The changes, oldest first.

events.name: revert
events.doc: A change was reverted: carries the change it is.

events.name: open
events.doc: A change was opened in the app: carries the change it is.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.doc: A field that suggests completions under it as it is typed into: a search over a site's catalogue, a mention, a command. The suggestions are what the view gives it; a chosen one fills the field and is reported.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty, and what names it to assistive technology.

props.name: max_visible
props.doc: How many suggestion rows show before the list scrolls.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be typed into now.

slots.name: suggestions
slots.doc: The completions to offer, in order.

events.name: accept
events.doc: The person took a suggestion, or the text they typed: carries what the field holds now.

events.name: cancel
events.doc: The person dismissed the list, keeping nothing.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The text typed, and where the edit of it goes. Taking a suggestion writes its value here and reports it.

components.name: Avatar
components.doc: Who someone is, at a glance: their picture, or their initials on their own colour. A thing or a group shows a glyph on a neutral square.

props.name: who
props.doc: The person or agent it shows.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is called when it shows no one: a group, a thing. Its initials and colour come from it.

props.name: glyph
props.doc: A glyph instead of initials, on a neutral square: a group, an app.

props.name: square
props.doc: A square rather than a circle: an account or a site, not a person.

components.name: Badge
components.doc: A small pill on another element: how many new things there are, a dot for something new, a short status ("Owner", "Beta"), or the mark of unsaved changes. It is never pressed.

props.name: text
props.doc: A short status in a word: "Owner", "Beta".

props.name: count
props.doc: How many new things there are, in your colour: nothing at 0, "99+" past 99.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Something new, without a number: a dot in your colour.

props.name: modified
props.doc: Unsaved changes: a dot in the primary ink, which is nobody's and not new.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A status the pill means, washed into it. A text badge is neutral unless said.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace a changed count plays at: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

components.name: Banner
components.doc: A message that stays in the page until it is resolved or dismissed: "You're offline", "This file changed on disk", "Storage is almost full". Its kind decides its glyph and colour; it carries a title, a message under it, up to two actions inside its box, and a dismiss button. It opens and closes in place, what follows moving with its edge.

props.name: title
props.doc: What happened, in a short sentence.

props.name: message
props.doc: What it means or what to do, under the title.

props.name: kind
props.doc: What kind of message it is: `neutral` unless said. A warning or an error is announced at once; the others when assistive technology is idle.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph instead of the kind's own.

props.name: action
props.doc: The label of its main action, at its trailing edge: "Retry".

props.name: secondary_action
props.doc: The label of a second action, before the main one: "Details".

events.name: act
events.doc: Its main action was pressed.

events.name: secondary_act
events.doc: Its second action was pressed.

events.name: dismiss
events.doc: Its dismiss button was pressed: stop showing it. A banner with this has the button, and closes as it is pressed.

components.name: BlockEditor
components.doc: A document: its paragraphs with their formatting, and each reference in it as the reader's own inline view of what it refers to (a person with their name, a channel, a task with its number), resolved under their permissions. Bound to a document's field it edits it, each edit written back as the value now reads and a change from elsewhere shown when the person is not typing there; given a value it shows that, read-only, and activating a reference opens it.

props.name: value
props.doc: Rich text it shows read-only, when it binds nothing.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while the editor is empty.

events.name: open_reference
events.doc: A reference in the text was activated, carrying the reference. Without one, the reference is opened.

bindings.name: rich
bindings.doc: The document it edits, as its paragraphs (a `RichText` field).

bindings.name: markdown
bindings.doc: The document it edits, as Markdown (a `Text` field), the same text round-tripped.

components.name: Board
components.doc: Cards in lanes, side by side: a kanban board, a pipeline, tasks by status. Dragging a card to another place in its lane or into another lane is reported by the card or lane it lands at; each card also opens, and offers its commands on its context menu, so nothing needs a drag.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the board is, for assistive technology.

slots.name: lanes
slots.doc: The lanes, in order.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.doc: Where a page is, as the path to it: each place it is in, a chevron between them, the page itself last. Pressing a place goes there. Where the path does not fit, its middle gives way first, the first place and the page itself staying.

props.name: root_icon
props.doc: A glyph before the first place: a drive, Home.

slots.name: segments
slots.doc: The places, outermost first; the last is the page itself, which is not pressed.

events.name: edit
events.doc: The empty space after the last place was pressed: offer the path as a field to type in.

components.name: Button
components.doc: A button: pressing it does one thing. Its role says what kind of thing, which decides its whole look: the window's one primary action, a destructive one, or an ordinary one.

props.name: label
props.doc: What pressing it does, in a word or two. An icon-only button is still named by it.

props.name: accessible_name
props.doc: How assistive technology names it, where that says more than the label shows: the charge reads "61%" beside its charging glyph and is named "61%, charging". Unset, the label names it.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the label, or instead of it when `icon_only`.

props.name: icon_only
props.doc: Show only the icon, the label naming the button to assistive technology.

props.name: faces
props.doc: Who is here, as their faces: up to three faces, then a face counting the rest, and nothing else on the button at any width. `icon_only`'s rule holds for it too: the label is the name assistive technology hears, naming the people ("Mia Clayton and Sam Okafor are here"). One press opens the roster of everyone here.

props.name: role
props.doc: What kind of action it is: `secondary` unless said, `plain` for an icon-only one.

props.name: toggled
props.doc: A toggle button, and whether it is on: on, it stands on a lift of its ground and is announced as pressed.

props.name: size
props.doc: How prominent it is: `regular` unless said.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be pressed now. A button with nothing to do never can.

props.name: description
props.doc: Why it cannot be pressed now, where the label does not say: the requirement an action does not meet. Its tooltip, and the description assistive technology reads beside the name it announces.

props.name: key
props.doc: The plain key that presses it while its window has the keyboard (and, on a row's action, while that row is selected), as the app declared it (`key: "e"`): the host answers it beside the pressed control's own event. Never drawn here; the header shows it at the action's menu row.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many new things wait behind it (unread notifications, new mail), on an icon-only button: a count standing on its icon's top-trailing corner, as an app icon's does, and nothing at 0. The button keeps room for it, so it never covers the control beside it. The label says the count to assistive technology.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Something new behind it without a number: a dot on its icon's corner.

props.name: alert
props.doc: It needs the person: the count or the dot in the warning tone, not in your colour.

props.name: in_menu
props.doc: It belongs in its header's menu rather than in the row ([`crate::widget::Button::in_menu`]).

props.name: group
props.doc: The run of its owner's actions it stands in (`group: "Due"`), as the app names it: the header's menu shows rows of one run together, under the run's own row.

events.name: press
events.doc: It was pressed (a click, Enter or Space, an assistive technology).

components.name: Card
components.doc: A summary of one thing on a surface of its own: a dashboard's tile, a resource's preview. Pressing it opens what it stands for.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the card stands for, named in its head.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things the card lists, as a count beside its title.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card summarizes.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one among its peers.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What the card shows, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The card was pressed: open what it stands for.

components.name: CardGrid
components.doc: Cards in equal, aligned columns: the apps of a store, the devices of a network, the paragraphs of a review. Each card is a resource, and pressing one opens it.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the grid is, for assistive technology.

props.name: card_width
props.doc: How wide a card is at least before the grid drops a column: small, regular or wide objects.

slots.name: cards
slots.doc: The cards, in order.

components.name: ChangeMark
components.doc: What someone else changed of a resource that the person looking has not seen yet: who, in which task run, and whether they made, changed or removed it. The host fills all but `of` from the resource's versions; activating it shows what they did.

props.name: of
props.doc: The resource whose changes it marks.

props.name: by
props.doc: Who made the newest change the person has not seen.

props.name: by_all
props.doc: Everyone who made one of the changes the person has not seen, in the order they changed it (its newest change last), each once.

props.name: said
props.doc: What the newest change did, in the words history says it with ("moved this to").

props.name: noun
props.doc: What one item of it is called, plural ("tasks"): the noun a window's count names.

props.name: run
props.doc: The task run it was part of, as its task is titled.

props.name: kind
props.doc: What they did: `created`, `changed` or `removed`.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many changes of it the person has not seen.

props.name: window
props.doc: It marks a window, in its header: it says how many changes and by whom.

props.name: more
props.doc: The window's document holds more resources than the mark counted: what it says is a lower bound, and says so.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What a window's mark opens: the views of its catch-up (*Since you looked*), placed by whoever placed the mark. A mark of a row has none, and shows who changed it alone.

events.name: activate
events.doc: Activated: show what they did, at the run that did it.

components.name: Sparkline
components.doc: A tiny trend line, with no axis, grid, title or legend: a recent history inside a table cell or a stat card. Fewer than two samples draw nothing.

props.name: samples
props.doc: The samples, oldest first.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the trend is of, as assistive technology announces it: "Requests per second".

props.name: max
props.doc: The vertical maximum, which may be more than the samples reach; without one it is the highest sample.

props.name: filled
props.doc: The area under the line filled in the same colour, which a sparkline draws unless it is told not to: `true` unless said.

props.name: smooth
props.doc: The line's shape between samples: the smooth curve rather than straight segments.

props.name: leading_dot
props.doc: A dot of this radius on the newest sample: the live edge of a streaming series.

props.name: tone
props.doc: What its line means, when it means something: a status, a person. Without one it is the theme's accent.

components.name: EmojiPicker
components.doc: A button that opens the emoji picker beside it; the emoji picked is reported (`on pick(e)`).

props.name: label
props.doc: What the button is called; "Add reaction" unless it says.

events.name: pick
events.doc: An emoji was picked: carries it.

components.name: Quote
components.doc: A message quoted where another answers it, or in the reply banner over the composer: a rule at its leading edge, who wrote it and the start of what it says. With `dismiss` it has a close button (the banner: "stop replying").

props.name: excerpt
props.doc: The start of what the quoted message says.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who wrote it.

props.name: caption
props.doc: What the quote is to the message (`Replying to`), shown before the author.

events.name: dismiss
events.doc: The close button was pressed. Without it there is no close button.

components.name: Reactions
components.doc: The reactions on something: a pill per emoji with how many reacted, yours drawn on; pressing one adds or takes back your reaction, and the add button opens the emoji picker for another. Each reports the emoji (`on toggle(e)`).

props.name: reactions
props.doc: Who reacted, by emoji: the reactions as the message holds them (`Map<Text, Set<Principal>>`).

props.name: emoji
props.doc: The emoji reacted with, in the order they were first used: the older form, with `by`, read while `reactions` is not given.

props.name: by
props.doc: Who reacted with each of `emoji`, in the same order.

props.name: can_react
props.doc: Whether the person may react; they may unless it says not.

events.name: toggle
events.doc: An emoji was pressed or picked: carries it. Your reaction with it is added, or taken back when you had reacted with it.

components.name: Checkbox
components.doc: A box that is marked or not, bound to what it edits (whether to be told of a reply, which rows a bulk action takes). A labelled box is one target, its label included.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it is for, beside the box: the whole row chooses it.

props.name: indeterminate
props.doc: Some of what it stands for is chosen: a mixed mark. The value stays `false`, so the next choose marks all of it.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen now.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace its mark plays at: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

events.name: check
events.doc: It was pressed: what a mark is, in the app's words. A task and every step under it are done in one thing to undo; with no `check`, a press changes the bound value.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: Whether it is marked, and where a mark made in it goes.

components.name: Chip
components.doc: A compact pill for a tag, a filter or a token: what a note is tagged with, a recipient, an applied filter. Pressing it opens or applies what it names; a chip that can be taken away has a trailing remove button; a filter chip shows whether it is on.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it names, in a word or two.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the label, for a chip that names an action rather than a value.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone the chip reads in: what it names is a status (a priority, a state of an item), and its pill is washed in that tone. `Neutral` for a chip that only names something.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the filter it stands for is on; without it the chip is no filter.

events.name: press
events.doc: It was pressed: open or apply what it names.

events.name: remove
events.doc: Its remove button was pressed: take it away. A chip with this has the button.

components.name: Chrome
components.doc: A bar or a dock's body: the theme's bar finish behind what the body holds.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the body is, for assistive technology.

props.name: shape
props.doc: How the body sits in its edge: edge to edge and square (the default), or an inset, rounded body.

props.name: edge
props.doc: The screen edge the body stands on. A square body casts no rule at it: a bar edge to edge with the screen has no line to mark, and a hairline a pixel inside its body would start its ground below the display's own edge.

props.name: material
props.doc: What the body is made of: the theme's bar body (the default), the theme's glass, or that glass made calm. A shell's bar and dock say which the person chose; every body that leaves it out draws the theme's bar body.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What the body holds.

components.name: CodeEditor
components.doc: Code to read or write, with line numbers and its language's colouring. What is typed edits the text it is bound to, each edit spliced in, never written over.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: language
props.doc: The language it colours (the language's own name, `rust`, `json`); plain text unless said.

props.name: min_lines
props.doc: The fewest lines it is tall for.

props.name: max_lines
props.doc: The most lines it is tall for; past them it scrolls.

props.name: gutter
props.doc: The line numbers show.

props.name: read_only
props.doc: It is read and copied, never edited.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The text it edits.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.doc: A colour, picked from a saturation and value field, a hue strip, the red, green and blue sliders, or a hex field; a palette of quick picks sits under them when given.

props.name: swatches
props.doc: A palette of quick picks under the sliders.

props.name: columns
props.doc: How many swatches stand in a row.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

events.name: change
events.doc: A colour was picked: carries its hex text.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The colour, as its hex text ("#3a7bd5"), and where a picked colour goes.

components.name: ColorSwatchPicker
components.doc: A grid of swatches, one chosen (a palette of accents): the chosen cell carries the ring. Each swatch is a colour by its hex text, shown in the theme's own samples.

props.name: swatches
props.doc: The swatches, as hex colours, in order.

props.name: columns
props.doc: How many stand in a row.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Which is chosen, counted from 0: none until a person chooses one.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

events.name: change
events.doc: A swatch was chosen: carries its index, counted from 0.

components.name: MenuButton
components.doc: A button that opens a menu of commands under it: a header's More button, a sort menu.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the menu holds, in a word or two. An icon-only button is still named by it.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the label, or instead of it when `icon_only`.

props.name: icon_only
props.doc: Show only the icon, the label naming the button to assistive technology.

props.name: role
props.doc: What kind of button it is: `secondary` unless said, `plain` for an icon-only one.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Actions offered on something (`actions(r)`), each a command after `items`.

props.name: subject
props.doc: The resource whose published actions this menu lists, which the host fills: a bar that lists the window in front's commands names the window and leaves the commands to it.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The commands, in order.

components.name: ConversationList
components.doc: A conversation, drawn as every conversation is drawn: each line on its own side, runs of one person's consecutive messages under their name once, a divider where the day changes, and the time and the delivery state under your own.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the conversation is, for assistive technology: "Conversation with Ada".

slots.name: lines
slots.doc: The lines, oldest first.

components.name: UnreadDivider
components.doc:
The divider as a widget, for a list built of widgets: a band across its column with its label at the trailing end, over the first line the reader had not read.
A described component, so a host that validates what an app sends builds it: the tilolang runtime places one per transcript over the row of the item the app named, and the host knows it from the toolkit's catalogue as it knows every other component.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is called, for assistive technology; empty for the toolkit's own word.

components.name: DataTable
components.doc: A table of resources as columns and rows: the attributes of a device, the songs in a library, the rules of a firewall. Each row is the resource it stands for and says what its columns read in it; pressing a header sorts by that column, and selecting or activating a row reports the row's resource.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the table is, for assistive technology.

props.name: fill
props.doc: The table takes the height its parent gives it and scrolls inside itself, rather than being as tall as its rows inside another scroll.

props.name: roomy
props.doc: Rows a finger's target tall, rather than a pointer target and a step.

props.name: selectable
props.doc: Whether pressing a row picks it.

slots.name: columns
slots.doc: The columns, in order.

slots.name: rows
slots.doc: The rows, in order.

events.name: select
events.doc: A row was selected: carries the resource it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: A row was activated (a double click, Enter, an assistive technology): carries the resource it shows.

state.name: selection
state.doc: The selected rows, by the resource each stands for.

components.name: DateField
components.doc: A day, shown as the person reads a day (with the time it is due at) and picked from a calendar that opens over it. A date that may be empty can be cleared, and the time it is due at is picked in the same popover, in the `time` slot.

props.name: at
props.doc: The time of day the day is due at, when its type pairs one with it (`9:00`): what the chip says after the day. The field picks it in its `time` slot; it only says it here.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name: what the date is for.

props.name: optional
props.doc: The date may be cleared: the calendar offers "Clear date".

slots.name: time
slots.doc: The control that picks the time of day the day is due at: `ui.TimeField(bind: t.at)`.

events.name: change
events.doc: A day was picked, or the date was cleared: carries the moment, or nothing for a cleared one.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The day, as the moment a component binds (its ISO text), and where a picked day goes.

components.name: DatePicker
components.doc: A month's calendar: the day chosen is ringed, today marked, and the arrows go between months. Days that hold something carry a dot.

props.name: marked
props.doc: Days that hold something (an event, a note): a dot under the number.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

events.name: change
events.doc: A day was chosen: carries the moment.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The day chosen, as the moment a component binds (its ISO text), and where choosing one goes.

components.name: DisclosureBand
components.doc: Content a view shows only while something is open (a tile's details under it, a row's section), standing in a column. When the view starts showing it, it unrolls from its top while what follows moves down with its edge; when the view stops, it rolls up. Under reduced motion it lands at once.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What it shows, in order.

components.name: Docked
components.doc: Content that fills its column above a bar that stays at the column's foot: a conversation above its composer. The bar stands in the column's page, a section's gap under the content and the page's gutter at its sides and below.

props.name: page_column
props.doc: The bar stands in the page column the content is read at: the readable measure, its left edge and its width, so a reply answers the messages above it in their own column rather than across a wide window.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What fills the column; it scrolls itself.

slots.name: foot
slots.doc: The bar at the foot, as tall as it needs.

components.name: DragRun
components.doc: A run of items — a dock's icons, a toolbar's tiles, a row of cards — reordered by dragging one. Each item is one `ui.DragItem`.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the run is, for assistive technology.

props.name: axis
props.doc: Whether the items lead to trailing (the default) or run top to bottom.

props.name: distribute
props.doc: Where the run's packed items sit along it: its leading edge (the default), its centre, its trailing edge, or spread between its ends. A run whose items fall in groups packs each group at its own edge; this places a run of one group, such as a dock.

props.name: align
props.doc: Where the items pack across the run: centred (the default).

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The items, in order.

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: What stands beside the items at the run's trailing end and is never moved: a taskbar's time and device status.

events.name: drop
events.doc: An item was let go in a new place: carries the resource it stands for and its place among the run's other items, from 0 — what `items.move(item, to: at)` takes.

components.name: Drawing
components.doc: Shapes drawn with the design system over a box of their own: a ring, a gauge, a small chart, a diagram. Colours are theme roles and widths tokens; a press reports which shape.

props.name: shapes
props.doc: The shapes, drawn in order, each over the ones before it.

props.name: meaning
props.doc: What it means, for assistive technology and agents.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it shows, as it is announced: "Disk 60% full".

props.name: value
props.doc: How far it has got, for a progress drawing: a fraction.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in logical pixels; a square of its height unless said.

props.name: height
props.doc: Its height in logical pixels.

events.name: press
events.doc: The person pressed a shape: carries its index in `shapes`.

components.name: DropZone
components.doc: Where files go: drag them here, or press the button to choose them (an import, a picture to swap, a file to open). At rest it is a dashed edge around a glyph and a title; while a drag hovers it takes your colour.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the zone takes, in a sentence: "Drop files to import".

props.name: message
props.doc: A line under the title saying what it accepts: "PNG or JPEG up to 50 MB".

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph for what it takes, a download arrow unless said.

props.name: action
props.doc: The label of a button offering the same route without dragging ("Choose files").

events.name: drop
events.doc: Files were dropped: carries their paths, as `List<Text>`.

events.name: choose
events.doc: The action's button was pressed: the view asks for the files its own way.

components.name: Dropdown
components.doc: One of a short list, chosen from a field that opens the list: a project, a sort order, a unit. The chosen one shows in the field; the list filters as it is typed into.

props.name: options
props.doc: What the list offers, in order.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What the field says while nothing is chosen, and what names it to assistive technology.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the field: the kind of thing chosen.

props.name: caption
props.doc: A caption above the field.

props.name: size
props.doc: How large the field is: `regular` unless said.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Take the row's width rather than fitting its content.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen from now.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: What is chosen, and where a choice goes.

components.name: EditableLabel
components.doc: A name that is typed over where it stands: a document's title, a tab's name, a list item's. Reading, it is text; pressed, it is a field whose Enter or click away commits the edit and whose Escape keeps the name it had.

props.name: role
props.doc: What it is set in: `body` unless said.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What it reads, dimmed, while the value is empty: "Untitled".

props.name: edit_on_click
props.doc: Begin an edit on a press, as a document's title renames in place; else on a double click.

props.name: clears_on_blank
props.doc: A blank entry empties the name rather than keeping the one before.

props.name: fill
props.doc: It takes the row's width, eliding a long name.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name, for a label no text beside it names.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title of the document the window is for, edited in place as its large title.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The name it shows, and where an edit of it goes.

components.name: EmptyState
components.doc: What a place says while it holds nothing: one sentence, and at most one action that starts filling it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Why it is empty, in one short sentence: "No notes yet".

props.name: message
props.doc: One more sentence under it, when the first does not say enough.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A large glyph above the title: the app's, or the kind of thing that would be here.

props.name: action
props.doc: The label of the one action that fills it: "New note".

props.name: inline
props.doc: Sit within the content, as a list without rows, rather than fill the window.

events.name: act
events.doc: The action was pressed.

components.name: EnumField
components.doc: A value among an enum's cases: the case it holds, as a chip in the case's glyph and tone, opening the cases to pick another.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the field is for ("Priority"), as the app named it: what a screen reader hears before the case itself.

slots.name: cases
slots.doc: The cases to pick from, in the enum's order.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The case it holds, by the case's name, and where a picked case goes.

components.name: BarGauge
components.doc: A labelled level as a bar: a disk's use, a quota, a battery. Its label stands over the track's start and its readout over its end; the fill turns warning, then danger, as it fills, unless the share has no status.

props.name: value
props.doc: How full it is, from 0 to 1.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it measures: "Storage", "Memory".

props.name: readout
props.doc: The reading over the track's end: "412 GB of 512 GB". Unless said, the share as a percentage is announced.

props.name: neutral
props.doc: A share with no status (storage by kind, a quota with room): the plain fill, never a status colour.

props.name: warning
props.doc: Where the fill turns warning, from 0 to 1: 0.6 unless said.

props.name: danger
props.doc: Where the fill turns danger, from 0 to 1: 0.85 unless said.

props.name: compact
props.doc: Smaller label and readout, for a dense grid of gauges.

components.name: ProgressRing
components.doc: How full something is, as a ring: a countdown, a download, the one hero reading of a screen (a speed test). A regular or large ring holds its readout and what it measures.

props.name: value
props.doc: How full it is, from 0 to 1.

props.name: readout
props.doc: The readout inside the ring: "42%", "23".

props.name: caption
props.doc: What the readout measures, under it: "seconds", "downloaded".

props.name: size
props.doc: How large it is: `regular` unless said, `small` inline beside text without a readout, `large` for the one hero reading of a screen.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A status the fill means: a failed transfer stays danger.

props.name: level
props.doc: A measured level rather than progress: the fill turns warning, then danger, as it fills.

components.name: Icon
components.doc: One glyph from the icon set, in the theme's ink: a kind of thing beside its name, a status mark. It says nothing to assistive technology, so the words beside it carry the meaning.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The glyph.

props.name: size
props.doc: How large it is: `regular` beside a row's label unless said, `small` beside a caption, `large` beside a title.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Recede beside its label, in secondary ink.

props.name: accent
props.doc: Take the accent's ink, for the one glyph that marks what is chosen.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A status the glyph means, in that status's colour: a passed check, a warning sign.

components.name: Image
components.doc: A picture: artwork, a photo, a cover. Its bytes are read from its address as it arrives; a picture that is not here yet keeps its place, and one whose bytes cannot be read shows the error mark, never nothing.

props.name: src
props.doc: Where the picture's bytes are: a content address (`tilo-blob://<hash>`) or a URL.

props.name: alt
props.doc: What the picture shows, as assistive technology announces it; without one it is decorative.

props.name: fit
props.doc: How it fills its box: `contain` (the whole picture, letterboxed, unless said), `cover` (cropped to fill) or `fill` (stretched to the box).

components.name: ImageCropEditor
components.doc: A picture with a crop its four corners set (a scanned page, a photo to trim): drag a corner to move it, or an edge's arrow keys, and it reports the crop each time it changes. The picture is letterboxed in its box; the crop is a share of the picture, never of the box.

props.name: image
props.doc: The picture to crop.

props.name: left
props.doc: The left crop edge, from 0 (the picture's left) to 1.

props.name: top
props.doc: The top crop edge, from 0 (the picture's top) to 1.

props.name: right
props.doc: The right crop edge, to 1 at the picture's right.

props.name: bottom
props.doc: The bottom crop edge, to 1 at the picture's bottom.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: The box's shape before the picture is here (its width over its height).

events.name: change
events.doc: The crop changed: carries its edges, left, top, right, bottom, each `0..=1`.

components.name: ImageViewer
components.doc: A picture to look at closely: scroll to zoom at the pointer, drag to pan, and a reset to the whole picture. It fills its box; the picture is letterboxed inside it.

props.name: image
props.doc: The picture to show.

props.name: alt
props.doc: What the picture is, as assistive technology announces it.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: The box's shape: its width over its height, which it stands at before the picture is here. The picture's own shape once it is.

components.name: InputHint
components.doc: The keys of a shortcut as drawn keycaps, in the person's own keyboard legends ("Strg" on a German keyboard, the Command key on a Mac), beside the command it runs. Never a typed string.

props.name: keys
props.doc: The keys of the chord, modifiers first: `["Ctrl", "Shift", "P"]`.

components.name: Link
components.doc: A hyperlink: primary ink with an underline, opening what it names when pressed, activated by Enter or Space, or from assistive technology. A link that names a resource opens it; one whose view gives it an `activate` acts.

props.name: url
props.doc: The address it opens (usually also what it says).

props.name: label
props.doc: What it shows, when that is not the address: "The docs".

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource it goes to: activating it opens the resource.

props.name: role
props.doc: What it is set in: `body` unless said.

events.name: activate
events.doc: It was pressed: what pressing it does, instead of opening its address.

components.name: ListRow
components.doc: A row of a list: what an item is, in one line, with the start of its content under it and a quiet fact on its trailing edge. Pressing it activates it: a list opens what it shows.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the item is: its title. A row that names none shows its item's.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: A quiet word before the title, on the same line and in the weaker ink: where an item came from, what it answers. The title shares its line, so a row that says one takes the room left after it.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the row shows, which activating the row opens.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: The line under the title: the start of the item's content, the last message.

props.name: note
props.doc: A line of the row's own under its text: what waits on the item and is not its content, as a proposal about it reads ("Suggested: move this to the end"). One line, elided; empty shows nothing.

props.name: meta
props.doc: When it happened or is due: the first fact of the row's facts column.

props.name: meta_tone
props.doc: The tone the trailing fact reads in, where the item it states has one: a day gone by is overdue. The UI host reads it off the day itself, as the one presenter gives it.

props.name: value
props.doc: The item's figure among its facts, as a setting shows it.

props.name: badge
props.doc: A short code in the leading column: a method, a kind.

props.name: mark
props.doc: A mark on the row's edge, after every other fact: pinned, starred, an item's priority.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone the mark and the row's checkbox ring read in: the item's priority, a theme role rather than a colour. `Neutral` draws them as the row's quiet ink.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph in the leading column: what kind of item it is.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether the row is selected in its list.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace the row's own motion plays at: its mark coming and going, and the row arriving, leaving and changing places in its list. Unset, the theme's.

props.name: dense
props.doc: The row stands dense: one quiet line at the caption's size with the small glyph, as tall as that line and its inset, for a reference under content rather than a list of items.

props.name: quiet
props.doc: The row reads as subordinate to the rows around it: its title in the weaker ink, as an outline's quieter branch does.

slots.name: avatar
slots.doc: Who the item is: their face among its facts, between when it is due and how far it has got.

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: A control on the trailing edge, which moves under the text when the row is narrow.

events.name: check
events.doc: The checkbox was pressed: what a check is, in the app's words. A task and every step under it are done in one thing to undo; with no `check`, a press changes the bound value.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The row was activated (a click, Enter, an assistive technology): open what it shows.

bindings.name: checkbox
bindings.doc: A checkbox in the leading column, bound to whether the item is done. A press on it asks the row's `check`, when it names one, instead of changing what it is bound to.

components.name: ControlRow
components.doc: A selectable row of a short list whose items carry their own controls (a layers panel, each layer's name beside its switches): a press none of its controls took chooses the row, and the chosen row is lifted off the ground it stands on.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the chosen one of its list.

slots.name: children
slots.doc: What the row holds, in order: its thumbnail, its name, and the controls its item has.

events.name: choose
events.doc: It was chosen: a press its controls did not take.

components.name: Map
components.doc: Places at points on a pannable, zoomable surface, each a view of its own.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the map is, for assistive technology.

props.name: ground
props.doc: Whether it is a desktop: the windows it holds stand on the desktop's ground ([`SurfaceLevel::Ground`](crate::widget::primitives::SurfaceLevel)), not on the content colour of the window the map is in.

slots.name: pins
slots.doc: The pins, in the order the map draws them (the last on top).

components.name: MediaGrid
components.doc: Cards in a grid: a library, an album's covers, a shelf of books, a set of channels. The cards reflow into as many columns as fit, every row's text as tall as its tallest so titles line up; `justified`, they make rows of photos that span the width at each picture's own shape.

props.name: size
props.doc: How large each card is: how wide a column holds.

props.name: justified
props.doc: The cards are photos at their own shape: justified rows that span the width, rather than equal columns.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The cards, in order.

components.name: MediaTransport
components.doc:
What is playing and the controls that steer it, as one band: the art and the song, like and lyrics, shuffle, previous, play/pause, next and repeat over the scrubber, the queue and the volume. It stands across the window's foot, under every column.
A control the view gives no event for is left out: an app that cannot shuffle shows no shuffle. A control the view leaves off changes what the band shows rather than what plays.

props.name: title
props.doc: The song's name, or what the band says with nothing playing.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: Who it is by, or why it cannot play.

props.name: error
props.doc: The subtitle says why it cannot play: it reads as an error.

props.name: art
props.doc: Its cover: a picture by its address, loaded as it arrives. Without one the placeholder shows the album's initials.

props.name: art_name
props.doc: The name the placeholder cover takes its initials and colour from (the album).

props.name: opens
props.doc: What a press on the art opens ("Open album", "Show lyrics"), as it is announced.

props.name: playing
props.doc: Whether it plays.

props.name: idle
props.doc: Nothing can play: every control rests disabled.

props.name: position
props.doc: Where it is, in seconds.

props.name: duration
props.doc: How long it is, in seconds.

props.name: volume
props.doc: The volume, `0..=1`; zero is muted.

props.name: shuffle
props.doc: Whether shuffle is on. Without it there is no shuffle control.

props.name: repeat
props.doc: What repeat repeats. Without it there is no repeat control.

props.name: liked
props.doc: Whether what plays is liked. Without it there is no like control.

props.name: lyrics
props.doc: Whether the lyrics show. Without it there is no lyrics control.

props.name: queue
props.doc: Whether the queue shows. Without it there is no queue control.

events.name: act_play_pause
events.doc: The play/pause control was pressed.

events.name: act_previous
events.doc: The previous control was pressed.

events.name: act_next
events.doc: The next control was pressed.

events.name: act_shuffle
events.doc: Shuffle was toggled.

events.name: act_repeat
events.doc: Repeat was toggled.

events.name: act_like
events.doc: What plays was liked or unliked.

events.name: act_mute
events.doc: The band was muted or unmuted.

events.name: act_seek
events.doc: The band was moved to a place in the song: carries `0..=1`.

events.name: act_volume
events.doc: The volume was set: carries `0..=1`.

events.name: act_lyrics
events.doc: The lyrics were asked for.

events.name: act_queue
events.doc: The queue was asked for.

components.name: NavList
components.doc: The places of an app, in its sidebar: choosing one shows it. Selection follows the person's choice and is reported, never kept by the app beside it.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the places are, as a heading over them.

props.name: selected
props.doc: The key of the place shown now.

props.name: rail
props.doc: A compact rail of icons that fits beside the content at every width.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The places, in order: places, and sections of them under a heading.

events.name: select
events.doc: A place was chosen; carries its key.

components.name: NavShell
components.doc: The one window shell: a sidebar of places, an overview list, the content and an inspector, side by side while they fit and one at a time, with Back, when they do not. The header of each column holds its title, its count and its actions.

props.name: content_kind
props.doc: What the content is, which sets the narrowest it still works at: `page` unless said.

props.name: title
props.doc: The content's title, in its header.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things the content lists, beside its title.

props.name: overview_title
props.doc: The overview column's title.

props.name: overview_count
props.doc: How many things the overview lists, beside its title.

props.name: sidebar_title
props.doc: The sidebar's title: what the places are of, the app's root.

props.name: can_go_back
props.doc: Whether the content's Back goes back now (a drill-down the app keeps).

slots.name: sidebar
slots.doc: The places of the app: a navigation list.

slots.name: overview
slots.doc: The list the content is chosen from.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What the window is for.

slots.name: inspector
slots.doc: Details of what the content shows, beside it.

slots.name: actions
slots.doc: The content's actions, in its header.

slots.name: overview_actions
slots.doc: The overview's actions, in its header: what the list's owner offers.

events.name: back
events.doc: The content's Back was pressed.

state.name: pane
state.doc: The column in front of a narrow window.

components.name: NumberInput
components.doc: A number with a step either side: a page size, a margin, a count. Typing in it, its steppers and the arrow keys all set the value, within its range.

props.name: label
props.doc: The number's spoken name, for a field with no label beside it.

props.name: min
props.doc: The smallest it may be.

props.name: max
props.doc: The largest it may be.

props.name: step
props.doc: How much one press of a stepper adds, 1 unless said.

props.name: precision
props.doc: Decimal places it shows: 0 unless said, for a whole number.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: A unit after the number, shown and not typed: "px", "%".

props.name: compact
props.doc: Smaller, for a toolbar: bare steppers, no field frame.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be changed now.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The value, and where a change of it goes.

components.name: PagePreview
components.doc: A page's shape in a print queue, a scan or a document picker: a sheet of paper with the lines a page holds, and "Page n of m" under it. It shows the shape and the progress, never the content, which it does not have.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the page is: its file's name, for assistive technology.

props.name: page
props.doc: Which page this is, counted from 1 (clamped into the count).

props.name: page_count
props.doc: How many pages the document has.

components.name: PageSidebar
components.doc: A rail down a document's side: one numbered thumbnail per page, the page open lifted, and, unless read-only, pages that can be dragged to reorder, copied, moved and added.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: A page's height over its width (`1.414` for A4, `792/612` for US Letter).

props.name: count
props.doc: How many pages the document has.

props.name: current
props.doc: Which page is open, counted from 0.

props.name: header
props.doc: The rail's title above the thumbnails: "Pages".

props.name: add
props.doc: The label of the button that adds a page at the foot ("Import…"). Without it there is no add button.

props.name: panel
props.doc: The rail paints its own panel (a document's whole side column). Without it it paints only the thumbnails, on the ground its host gives it.

events.name: select
events.doc: A page was chosen: carries its index, from 0.

events.name: reorder
events.doc: A page was moved: carries its old index, then its place among the others.

events.name: duplicate
events.doc: A page was to be copied: carries its index.

events.name: delete
events.doc: A page was to be removed: carries its index.

events.name: add_page
events.doc: A page was to be added.

components.name: PageSlide
components.doc:
One page of a stack, in the place a view shows it, with the page it replaced leaving while the view swaps the two: a panel that opens a deeper page of its own, and Back that slides it away again.
A page that goes deeper arrives from the side its level names, and the page it replaced leaves toward the other; a page that goes shallower runs the motion the other way. A view that puts a different page at the same level (a list's item opened in the page the list showed) changes it where it stands, and nothing moves.

props.name: level
props.doc: How deep the page stands: 0 the first page, 1 the page it opens.

slots.name: page
slots.doc: The page it shows.

components.name: PersonField
components.doc: A form's person: who is doing it, shown as their avatar and name, and picked from the workspace's members and agents. "Me" picks the person the view is shown to, "No one" clears it.

props.name: people
props.doc: The people to offer, after "Me" and "No one": the workspace's members and agents, as the platform's membership names them.

props.name: me
props.doc: The person the view is shown to: the list's "Me".

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The person's identity, as the person a component binds (its identity text, empty for nobody), and where a pick goes.

components.name: PictureChoice
components.doc: A choice among pictures whose meaning is visual: a text size, a pointer size, a colour filter. Each tile shows its picture over its name, and the chosen tile carries the selection edge.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Which tile is chosen, counted from 0: none until a person chooses one.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen from now.

slots.name: options
slots.doc: The tiles, in order.

events.name: change
events.doc: A tile was chosen: carries its index, counted from 0.

components.name: BarChip
components.doc: One bar control that stands for people: their faces, a label and a press. A chip with faces opens who is here, an invite opens the host's own invite flow; a press reaches the view's `press` event, which is the same action the palette, scripts and agents invoke.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the chip is for assistive technology (and its tooltip when it shows only a glyph).

props.name: label
props.doc: The words beside the faces: "Editing", "Invite".

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the faces: a watch, an invitation.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: A trailing glyph: the chevron of a chip that opens a panel.

props.name: who
props.doc: Who it stands for, in order: the faces it shows, then a count for everyone past them.

props.name: open
props.doc: The chip's panel is open: it holds the whole lift.

props.name: focused
props.doc: Keyboard focus. The ring shows only while focus is visible.

props.name: label_width
props.doc: The most the label may grow to before it elides.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A person whose presence colour washes the chip's body: who the state it says is about.

events.name: press
events.doc: A press: the chip's own action.

components.name: DisclosureRow
components.doc: A row whose body opens in place under it: a device's details, a run's log, a setting's options. Its chevron turns as it opens, and what follows moves down with it. A press on the row, Enter or Space opens and closes it.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the row is, on its first line.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: A line under the title, in secondary ink.

props.name: side
props.doc: A quiet line at the far end of the title's line: who did it and when.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the title: the kind of thing it is.

props.name: who
props.doc: A person before the title, as an avatar: who did the work the row stands for.

props.name: signal
props.doc: How strong a radio network's signal is, before the title, for a row that is a network.

props.name: expanded
props.doc: Whether the row is open. Unless given, the row keeps it.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace its body unfolds at, and the pace a view's open or close takes: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What opens under the row, in order.

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: One control on the row's trailing edge, before the chevron (a device's Connect): it acts without opening the row.

events.name: toggle
events.doc: The row was opened or closed; carries whether it is open now.

components.name: Facts
components.doc: Separate facts in one row, each an optional glyph and its text, with space between them and no separator glyph: "12 files", "3 MB", "Edited today" are three facts. Where the row is too narrow, the facts that matter least give way first.

slots.name: facts
slots.doc: The facts, in order.

components.name: KeyHints
components.doc: Shortcuts and what they do, side by side: each hint the drawn keycaps of a chord and its label ("Enter Save", "Esc Cancel"), in the person's own keyboard legends. Never a sentence with a separator glyph.

slots.name: hints
slots.doc: The hints, in order.

components.name: ModalDialog
components.doc: A question over the window: a dimmed page, a sheet with a title, the view's content, and up to three answers. Escape or a click on the scrim closes it; Enter fires the main answer, except in a destructive question, where Enter is the safe one.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the question is, as its title (name the action: "Delete 3 notes?").

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the title naming what asks.

props.name: description
props.doc: What assistive technology says after the title.

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether it is open. A closed dialog paints nothing and takes no input.

props.name: primary
props.doc: The main answer's label ("Delete"): the inverted button, and what Enter fires.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: The other answer's label, usually Cancel. Escape fires it.

props.name: tertiary
props.doc: A third answer's label, standing apart ("Don't save"). Enter never fires it.

props.name: destructive
props.doc: The main answer destroys something: it is a destructive button, and Enter is the safe answer instead.

props.name: primary_enabled
props.doc: The main answer cannot be taken yet. A dialog with this has it disabled.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: The view's content, inside the sheet.

events.name: act_primary
events.doc: The main answer was taken.

events.name: act_secondary
events.doc: The other answer was taken.

events.name: act_tertiary
events.doc: The third answer was taken.

events.name: dismiss
events.doc: It was closed (Escape, the scrim, or a click on Cancel): a dialog with this closes as it is.

components.name: FloatingPanel
components.doc:
A floating panel a view places itself: a header slot, a body and a footer slot, on the floating material.
A view rarely places one: a menu is a `Popover` beside its control, a question a `ModalDialog`, and the window's chrome belongs to the shell (§7c). It is for the surface a canvas's own inspector or a document's navigator stands on.

props.name: width
props.doc: A fixed width, in logical pixels (a utility panel).

slots.name: body
slots.doc: The panel's body.

slots.name: header
slots.doc: Its header, above the body; a field there renders embedded.

slots.name: footer
slots.doc: Its footer, under the body.

components.name: Popover
components.doc: A menu or a small form beside its control: the one anchored floating panel. The view's content is inside it.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its accessible name (a menu says what it chooses: "Refresh interval").

props.name: open
props.doc: Whether it is open.

props.name: side
props.doc: The side of its anchor it prefers: `below` unless said.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: Its content.

events.name: dismiss
events.doc: It was closed (Escape, or a press outside it): a popover with this closes as it is.

components.name: PopoverButton
components.doc: A button that opens a popover anchored to itself: a filter's options, a share sheet, a picker of values. A press opens it, and it closes by a second press, Escape, or a press outside it.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the button is called, as it is announced.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph instead of the label, on an icon-only button.

props.name: side
props.doc: The side of the button it opens on: `below` unless said.

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Whether it opens at the button's trailing edge instead of its leading edge.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: The popover's content.

components.name: TextStack
components.doc: A title over a secondary line, with an optional third line under it, in fixed roles and at fixed gaps: a file's name over its folder, a person over their role. Each line is one line, cut short with an ellipsis; two facts never share a line.

props.name: title
props.doc: The first line, in the body's medium weight.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: The line under the title, in secondary ink.

props.name: tertiary
props.doc: A third line, in tertiary ink.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A status the secondary line means, in its colour: "Failed" in danger.

props.name: dense
props.doc: A dense row's or a bar's stack: a smaller title.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.doc: How far something is: a transfer, an import, a sync. Without a value it is under way with no known end, a segment sliding across the track. A measured level (a disk, a quota) turns warning and then danger as it fills.

props.name: value
props.doc: The share done, from 0 to 1. Without it the bar is under way with no known end.

props.name: label
props.doc: What is under way ("Uploading"). A named bar announces its progress to assistive technology without taking focus.

props.name: tone
props.doc: A status the fill means: a failed transfer stays danger.

props.name: level
props.doc: A measured level rather than progress: the fill turns warning, then danger, as it fills.

props.name: warning
props.doc: Where a level turns warning, from 0 to 1: 0.6 unless said.

props.name: danger
props.doc: Where a level turns danger, from 0 to 1: 0.85 unless said.

components.name: PropertyList
components.doc: Facts about one thing, a label beside each value: a contact's details, a file's.

props.name: striped
props.doc: Shade every other row, for a long list read across.

slots.name: properties
slots.doc: The facts, in order.

components.name: QrCode
components.doc:
A QR code of a payload, for a phone's camera to read: a pairing handshake, an invite.
Its payload may be private (a pairing secret): give `secret`, and it is left out of screenshots, recordings and screens, and never spoken by assistive technology.

props.name: payload
props.doc: What the code carries, as the scanner reads it.

props.name: alt
props.doc: What scanning it means, as assistive technology announces it; "QR code" unless said.

props.name: secret
props.doc: The payload is private pairing material: leave the code out of screenshots and recordings, and never speak it.

components.name: Time
components.doc: A moment shown as how long ago it was, or how far ahead: `2 min ago`, `Yesterday`, `in 3 min`, in the person's language and time zone. It changes when what it says does, and wakes the window for nothing else.

props.name: at
props.doc: The moment.

props.name: role
props.doc: What the text is, which sets its size and weight: `body` unless said.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: It stands beside the content it is about, in secondary ink: when a change was made.

props.name: past
props.doc: The moment has already happened, as a message received or an entry logged: a moment the reader's clock has not reached yet (the clock of the device that wrote it runs ahead) reads `just now`, never ahead.

components.name: RichInput
components.doc: A field to type rich text into, bound to the rich text it edits: each reference a completion picks is written as a reference, which every reader sees as their own inline view of what it names.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be typed into now.

props.name: speakers
props.doc: Who spoke last in what it writes into, newest first: whom its `@` drawer offers first, under "In this conversation". The system gives it to every rich input.

props.name: people
props.doc: Who can read what it writes into: whom its `@` drawer offers, under "Members". The system gives it to every rich input; given no one, the drawer offers the workspace's roster.

events.name: submit
events.doc: Enter was pressed: what was written is done (a composer's message is sent). With it, Enter sends rather than breaking the line; Shift+Enter still breaks it.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The rich text it edits.

components.name: RichTextLine
components.doc: One line of text, edited in place: a block editor's cell, a composer's message. It carries its text and its inline marks, and reports the keys that would carry the edit out of the line itself (Enter, Shift+Enter, Backspace at the start), so a host composing several lines can split or join them.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: role
props.doc: How the text reads: `body` unless said.

props.name: mono
props.doc: The text is monospace (code).

props.name: wrap
props.doc: The line wraps to its width rather than scrolling across.

events.name: enter
events.doc: Enter was pressed: the line ends at this byte.

events.name: soft_enter
events.doc: Shift+Enter was pressed: the line breaks at this byte, a soft break.

events.name: backspace_at_start
events.doc: Backspace at the start was pressed: the line joins the one before it.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The text it edits.

components.name: Scroll
components.doc: A body that scrolls under its column's fixed header: its content as tall as it is, the part of it the column has room for shown.

props.name: follow_end
props.doc: Open at the end of the content and stay there while it grows, unless the person scrolled away from the end: a conversation's transcript, whose newest line is last.

props.name: across
props.doc: Scroll sideways instead: a row wider than its column, such as a board's lanes.

props.name: both
props.doc: Scroll both ways: a 2D surface whose content is wider and taller than its column, such as a desk of strips. Takes precedence over `across`.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What scrolls.

components.name: Section
components.doc: A group of related content under an optional title: rows of a list, fields, a figure. A collapsible section opens and closes under its title.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the group is about.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Whether its title opens and closes it.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace its content arrives and leaves at, and its title's reveal: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: What it holds, in order.

events.name: toggle
events.doc: A collapsible section opened or closed; carries whether it is open now.

state.name: expanded
state.doc: Whether a collapsible section shows what it holds.

components.name: ObjectHeader
components.doc: The head of a detail view: an avatar or a glyph, the thing's name as a title and one caption line under it, "Ada Lovelace" over "ada@example.org", a password's site over its address.

props.name: title
props.doc: The thing's name.

props.name: caption
props.doc: One line under the name: an address, a URL, a kind.

props.name: who
props.doc: A person before the name, as their avatar.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the name: the kind of thing it is.

props.name: square
props.doc: The avatar is square: an account or a site, not a person.

components.name: StatusLine
components.doc: A status in a sentence: a dot in the status's colour and a caption beside it, "Engine running", "3 containers stopped". For a list's footer or a detail's state; it is never pressed.

props.name: text
props.doc: The sentence: "Synced 2 minutes ago".

props.name: status
props.doc: What state it says: `active` (running, connected, healthy) unless said, `warning` (needs attention soon), `error` (failed, or offline unexpectedly), `idle` (present but inactive).

props.name: who
props.doc: A person whose presence it says, in their colour, instead of a status.

components.name: ShortcutRecorder
components.doc: A keyboard shortcut as keycaps that are the control: press them and type the new chord. A reset appears while the chord differs from its default.

props.name: default
props.doc: The chord it started as, which its reset puts back.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name: the command the shortcut runs.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The chord, as its text ("Ctrl+Shift+K"), and where a recorded one goes.

components.name: SignalMeter
components.doc: How strong a radio signal is (a Wi-Fi network, a mobile network), as four bars of rising height, one icon square in size. It names itself by its level: "Strong signal".

props.name: level
props.doc: How strong the signal is: `unknown` fills no bar.

components.name: Skeleton
components.doc: The shape of content still on its way, drawn where it will stand and at its size, so nothing moves when it arrives. It never shimmers, and it says "Loading" to assistive technology.

props.name: shape
props.doc: What it stands in for: `text` unless said.

props.name: lines
props.doc: How many lines: of text (3 unless said), or under a row's title (none unless said).

props.name: leading
props.doc: What leads a row: a mark, an avatar or a tile.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: The shape of a media card's art: `square` unless said.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A value along a track: a level, a volume, a share. Dragging the knob or pressing the track sets it, and the arrow keys step it; Shift drags finely. It reads its own value when said.

props.name: label
props.doc: The value's spoken name, for a slider with no label beside it: "Volume".

props.name: min
props.doc: The lowest value, 0 unless said.

props.name: max
props.doc: The highest value, 1 unless said.

props.name: step
props.doc: Values snap to multiples of this from the minimum; the arrow keys move one step.

props.name: shows_value
props.doc: Show the value in words beside the track: "72%".

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be moved now.

events.name: change
events.doc: The person moved it: carries the value it is at now. What a slider over a value the view does not hold runs (a device's volume, changed by its own action), as its value is given rather than bound.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The value, and where a change of it goes.

components.name: Spinner
components.doc: Something under way whose length is not known: four dots turning. It holds still under reduced motion. Where the share done is known, a progress bar or ring says how far it is.

props.name: label
props.doc: What is under way ("Loading messages"), as assistive technology names it.

props.name: beside
props.doc: Size it to one line of this text, for a spinner beside a status line. Unless said it stands alone at its own size.

components.name: StatGroup
components.doc: A set of stat tiles that reflows by width: all in one row when they fit, then half per row (a 2 by 2 for four), then one per row. The tiles are separated by space, never boxed.

slots.name: tiles
slots.doc: The tiles, in order.

components.name: StatTile
components.doc: One number and what it measures, on the content ground: a dashboard's reading, a backup's size. A tile reads top to bottom: its label, the value with its unit, a note, which way it moved, and a sparkline of its recent readings. A tile that opens a detail is pressed.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the number measures, in sentence case: "Active users".

props.name: value
props.doc: The number, as it reads: "1,284", "99.9".

props.name: unit
props.doc: Its unit, after the value: "GB", "ms".

props.name: note
props.doc: A neutral qualifier read with the value: "of 2 TB", "estimated".

props.name: change
props.doc: How it changed, beside an arrow of its trend: "12% this week".

props.name: trend
props.doc: Which way it moved: `up` unless said, when it has a change. Whether that is good is its tone, not the arrow.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The state of what it measures, as a ticker down its leading edge: a failed backup is danger, a healthy tunnel success.

props.name: hero
props.doc: The one hero number of a screen, set large.

props.name: samples
props.doc: Its recent readings, oldest first, as a sparkline under it.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one, when it opens a detail.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The tile was pressed: open its detail.

components.name: Stepper
components.doc: Where a person is in a short sequence: a setup wizard's steps, an import's. Each step is a station with a disc and its name; a done one carries a check and may be gone back to. Too narrow for its stations, it reads "Step 2 of 4" over the current step.

props.name: steps
props.doc: The steps, in order.

props.name: current
props.doc: Which step is current, counted from 0. None before the first step starts: every station waits.

events.name: station
events.doc: The step gone back to: carries its index. Without it, no station takes the pointer.

components.name: TabStrip
components.doc:
A frame's tabs, in one row above its content: the shell's tab strip.
The chosen tab stands lifted off the strip's ground, and every pill says who is at its resource now. Choosing a pill activates that tab; a pill's close chip closes it; dragging one within the strip reorders it, and letting one go outside the strip hands it to the frame under the pointer.

props.name: active
props.doc: The resource whose tab shows: the tab in front.

props.name: focused
props.doc: Whether this frame has the keyboard: its tab strip says so.

slots.name: tabs
slots.doc: The tabs, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: Told a tab was chosen: carries the resource of the pill chosen.

events.name: close
events.doc: Told a tab's close chip was pressed: carries that tab's resource.

events.name: reorder
events.doc: Told a pill was dropped at a new place in the strip: carries the tab moved and its place among the strip's, from 0.

events.name: detach
events.doc: Told a pill was dragged out of the strip and let go: carries the tab and where it was let go, as [`pack_point`] packs the window's coordinates. The shell puts the tab in the frame there, or makes one.

components.name: Text
components.doc: Words on the page, set in one of the design system's text roles. What it says is content, never looked up as interface copy.

props.name: value
props.doc: What it says.

props.name: role
props.doc: What the text is, which sets its size, weight and face: `body` unless said.

props.name: numeric
props.doc: A number that changes: tabular figures, so it does not jitter as it changes.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: What it says stands beside the content it is about, in secondary ink: "edited" after a message, "Pinned" over it.

props.name: lines
props.doc: How many lines it takes: what does not fit is elided at the last of them, so a clamp holds however long the words are. Unset, it wraps to as many lines as its width needs.

props.name: truncate
props.doc: It elides at the room it is given rather than wrapping wider, so its box may shrink to nothing and what does not fit ends in an ellipsis: a title in a narrow card.

components.name: TextInput
components.doc: A field to type text into, bound to the text it edits. Each edit is spliced into that text, never written over it, so people typing in the same text at once all keep what they typed.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: What to type, shown while it is empty.

props.name: lines
props.doc: Room for this many lines: the field wraps and grows with what is typed.

props.name: title
props.doc: The title of the document the window is for, edited in place as its large title.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be typed into now.

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: It is where the person types next (an entry a command just opened): it takes the keyboard as soon as it is in the window, once.

props.name: changed_by
props.doc: Someone else changed the text and the person has not seen it yet: the field takes their colour. The host sets it, from what the field is bound to (task-legibility §3).

props.name: previous
props.doc: What the text was before that change, said when the field is hovered.

props.name: entry
props.doc: The entry at the end of a list: what is typed makes an item when Enter or leaving the field commits it, and the field clears; nothing typed leaves nothing (Escape, or leaving it empty). Its own draft, not a record: the item exists once it is committed.

props.name: key
props.doc: The plain key that focuses this control while its window has the keyboard, as the app declared it (`key: "Ctrl+N"`): a window's primary action brings the person to the list's entry rather than making an empty item. Never drawn here.

events.name: submit
events.doc: Enter was pressed: what was typed is done (a list's entry), carried with it. With it, Enter ends the text rather than breaking its line; Shift+Enter still breaks a wrapping field's line.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The text it edits.

components.name: TimeField
components.doc: The time of day a day is due at: the hour and the minute it is due at, with "Remove time" beside them, or a quiet "Add time" while it has none. It stands in the `time` slot of a [`DateField`](crate::widget::DateField), so the day and its time read as one fact.

events.name: change
events.doc: A time was picked or removed: carries the time of day, or nothing for a removed one.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The moment, as a bound field holds it (`09:00`, or the ISO text of an instant), and where a picked time of day goes.

components.name: TimePicker
components.doc: A time of day, as three spinners for hours, minutes and seconds: the arrows step a spinner and so does the wheel over its cell. It is the time in the person's own zone today.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name.

events.name: change
events.doc: The moment changed: carries the instant, at the time chosen today.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: The moment, as the instant a component binds (its ISO text): today at the time chosen. A change sets the time kept in it.

components.name: Toggle
components.doc: A switch: the same two states as a checkbox, for a setting that takes effect at once rather than when a form is sent. Its knob slides to the side it turns to.

props.name: label
props.doc: The setting's name, read beside its state by assistive technology.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be turned now.

bindings.name: value
bindings.doc: Whether it is on, and where a turn of it goes.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.doc: A small set of choices, one of which is made: an alignment, a density, a unit. The chosen one is a thumb lifted off the track. What switches what a window shows is [`ViewTabs`].

props.name: selected
props.doc: Which choice is made, counted from 0: none until the person makes one.

props.name: caption
props.doc: A label over the strip naming what it chooses between.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name, for a strip its caption does not name.

props.name: size
props.doc: How large its segments are: `regular` unless said.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Share the row's width equally instead of fitting each label.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen from now.

slots.name: options
slots.doc: The choices, in order.

events.name: change
events.doc: A choice was made: carries the index of the chosen option, counted from 0.

components.name: ViewTabs
components.doc: Tabs that switch what a window's content shows: a request's Params, Headers and Body, a container's Logs and Stats. Assistive technology meets them as a tab list whose chosen tab is selected, not checked.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Which tab shows, counted from 0.

props.name: label
props.doc: Its spoken name for assistive technology.

props.name: size
props.doc: How large the tabs are: `regular` unless said.

props.name: fill
props.doc: Share the row's width equally instead of fitting each label.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen from now.

slots.name: tabs
slots.doc: The tabs, in order.

events.name: change
events.doc: Another tab was chosen: carries its index, counted from 0.

components.name: Toolbar
components.doc: A strip of commands: plain buttons in a row, groups split by hairlines, toggles that stand lifted while on. However narrow the window, every command stays reachable: those that do not fit go to a More menu at the end, the least important first.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stand the commands in a column rather than a row.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: Its commands, separators and spacers, in order.

components.name: TreeView
components.doc: A tree of nodes: a file explorer, a project's files, the layers of a drawing, a book's pages. Each node is the resource it stands for; opening a branch shows the nodes under it, and selecting or activating a node reports its resource.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the tree is, for assistive technology.

props.name: fill
props.doc: The tree takes the height it is given and scrolls inside itself, rather than sizing to the rows inside another scroll.

props.name: hide_root
props.doc: The tree's root node — the tree itself, labelled with its `name` — is not a row: the nodes at the top level are, at the first depth. Off, the tree's name stands over them as a row of its own. Hide it where a heading or a page title already names the tree.

props.name: single_click
props.doc: A press selects and activates in one, as a navigator sidebar does; a double click activates otherwise.

props.name: selection_follows_focus
props.doc: Moving through the rows with the keyboard selects them as it goes.

props.name: multi_select
props.doc: Whether several nodes may be selected at once (Ctrl-click, Shift-click).

props.name: reorder
props.doc: Rows move: by dragging one onto another (before it, inside it or after it), and by `Tab` and `Shift-Tab` to indent and outdent, `Alt-Up` and `Alt-Down` to reorder among siblings. A move is reported by the node it lands at ([`TreeViewNodeProps::drop`], [`TreeViewNodeProps::into`]) or, at the top level's end, by the tree's [`Self::drop`].

props.name: tab_indents
props.doc: `Tab` and `Shift-Tab` indent and outdent the focused row. On by itself with [`Self::reorder`]; off, `Tab` moves the focus on as it otherwise would.

props.name: motion
