props.doc: The pace its own motion plays at: branches unfolding, rows arriving and leaving. Unset, the theme's.

slots.name: nodes
slots.doc: The nodes, in order, parents before their children.

events.name: select
events.doc: A node was selected: carries the resource it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: A node was activated (a double click, Enter, an assistive technology): carries the resource it shows.

events.name: drop
events.doc: A node was dropped at the end of the top level, past every row: carries the node that moved.

state.name: expanded
state.doc: The nodes open now, by the resource each stands for. Given, it is where the view says the tree is; without it the tree keeps what a person opened.

state.name: selection
state.doc: The nodes selected, by the resource each stands for.

components.name: VideoPlayer
components.doc:
A video with its playback controls over it: play/pause, the scrubber, the volume, mute and fullscreen. The app's player is the one truth; what the person does reaches the view as its events.
The video's bytes are a camera, a capture, or the medium it names (a file or a stream), which the toolkit opens on the engine its app hands in.

props.name: title
props.doc: The video's title, for assistive technology.

props.name: poster
props.doc: A still shown before the first frame: a picture by its address.

props.name: playing
props.doc: Whether it plays.

props.name: position
props.doc: Where it is, in seconds.

props.name: duration
props.doc: How long it is, in seconds.

props.name: source
props.doc: Where it is stored, as a `file://` address or a URL the engine fetches.

props.name: volume
props.doc: The volume, `0..=1`.

props.name: muted
props.doc: Whether it is muted.

events.name: set_playing
events.doc: Play or pause was pressed: carries `true` when it plays.

events.name: seek
events.doc: It was moved to a place in the video: carries `0..=1`.

events.name: set_volume
events.doc: The volume was set: carries `0..=1`.

events.name: fail
events.doc: The player could not show its video: carries what the engine said.

components.name: VirtualList
components.doc: A long list of rows that costs only the rows on screen: each is built when it scrolls into view. Selection follows the person's choice and is reported with the item it shows; the list is one focus stop.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the list is, for assistive technology.

props.name: selection_follows_focus
props.doc: Moving through the rows with the keyboard selects them, as a list whose selection shows beside it does; a click or a tap on a row then activates it, as choosing an entry of an overview does.

props.name: in_column
props.doc: The list is a column's whole body: its rows' text starts where the column's header starts its title.

props.name: transcript
props.doc: A conversation: each row stands in the page column, the list opens at its newest row and follows it.

props.name: page_column
props.doc: Each row stands in the page column, at the readable measure every page sets its blocks on, a section's gap under the row before it. A list read from its first row to its last (a conversation's messages, a document's replies) keeps the measure without following its end as a transcript does.

props.name: tail_title
props.doc: The title over the list's tail group: the rows whose item says it is one of those done with ([`ListItemProps::tail`]) stand after every group, under it, closed until the person opens them. `None` leaves those rows among the others.

props.name: tree
props.doc: The rows stand as a tree: each indented under the row of the item it names as its parent ([`ListItemProps::parent`]), with a disclosure on the rows that have subtasks, folding them away. The list works the tree out of the items as it builds their rows.

props.name: ungrouped_title
props.doc: The title over the group of rows whose item names no group: a list grouped by a thing some items lack (a day, a place) heads those rows with it, never folding them under the last group that names one. The rows keep the order their list gives. `None` leaves them among the others.

props.name: multi_select
props.doc: The list holds more than one selected row: a click with ctrl (or cmd) adds or takes away the row it lands on, one with shift takes the range from the last row chosen, and Escape puts the selection away. Without it a click chooses the one row the window shows.

props.name: unread
props.doc: The item a conversation's reader had not seen when they opened it (`first_unseen(c)`): the "New messages" divider stands over the row that shows it, and while that is above the view a pill at the foot offers to take the reader back to it. `None` draws neither. The list works out the row as it builds, so the same list keeps its rows and only the two the divider moved between build again.

props.name: motion
props.doc: The pace its rows arrive, leave and change places at, and the rows it builds move at when they say nothing themselves: the theme's unless it says otherwise.

slots.name: rows
slots.doc: The items, in order.

slots.name: removed
slots.doc: Items someone else removed that the person has not seen go: each a row after the items, its title struck through. The UI host places them.

events.name: select
events.doc: A row was selected: carries the item it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: A row was activated (a click, Enter, an assistive technology): carries the item it shows.

events.name: selected
events.doc: The selection changed: carries the items selected, in the order they stand, and none when the selection was put away.

state.name: chosen
state.doc: The items selected, in the order they stand: the selection a host keeps for its person, given back so a list built again shows it as they left it.

state.name: scroll
state.doc: How far the list is scrolled, in logical pixels.

components.name: WebView
components.doc: A page, live: a browser's content, a help document, a web app embedded in a view. Its address bar, navigation and permission prompts belong to its host: this is the page alone, and the app reports what the page navigated to as its events.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the page is, for assistive technology.

props.name: uri
props.doc: The page's address, which it opens at first.

events.name: navigate
events.doc: The page navigated (the person followed a link): carries the address.

events.name: fail
events.doc: The page could not load: carries what the engine said.

components.name: WindowFrame
components.doc: A window standing on a desktop: the window surface with its edge and shadow, holding the window's content and its controls, clipped to its radius.

props.name: name
props.doc: The window's name: what assistive technology reads, and the title of the frame's own bar when the content has no header row to hold the controls.

props.name: focused
props.doc: Whether it is the window in front, the one the keyboard goes to.

props.name: lists_actions
props.doc: The shell lists this window's actions where the person reaches them (the desktop bar's window menu): its header's actions that do not fit give way with no door of their own. Without it what does not fit goes behind the header's door.

slots.name: controls
slots.doc: The frame's controls (close, and what else the shell offers on the window), at the trailing end of the window's bar.

slots.name: tabs
slots.doc: The places the window shows, as its tabs: the bar is theirs while there are any, and the content is the tab in front. Empty for a window of one place, whose bar is the place's own header or the frame's.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: The window's content, filling the window.

components.name: WindowPreview
components.doc: A window's live picture, at the rectangle the preview stands at: the compositor draws the window's own pixels there, so the preview draws nothing and takes no input.

props.name: window
props.doc: The window whose picture shows here: its key in the desk's reading (`Win.key`).

semantics.label: window
semantics.not_in_gallery: a preview draws nothing: the compositor draws the window's own pixels there, and a gallery entry has no window to show

components.name: WindowWell
components.doc: A place's window, at the rectangle the well stands at: the app's own window shows there, so the well draws nothing and takes no input.

props.name: place
props.doc: The place whose window shows here: the tab id the desktop model gives the window when it maps (shell.md §8).

semantics.label: place
semantics.not_in_gallery: a well draws nothing: the place's own window is composited there, so a gallery window has no well to show

components.name: ActivityEntry
components.doc: One change of a document: what it did, who did it and when.

props.name: item
props.doc: The change it is: its stable key, what reverting or opening it reports, and where its band and selection stand across changes.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who made the change.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was made.

props.name: summary
props.doc: What the change did, in a sentence: "Renamed the card", "Moved to Done".

props.name: kind
props.doc: What kind of change it is: it draws the row's glyph and says whether it can be reverted.

props.name: artifact
props.doc: What kind of resource it changed.

components.name: MenuSeparator
components.doc: A rule between groups of a menu's commands.

components.name: EmojiBar
components.doc: A row of emoji to react with, at the top of a menu: the ones the person uses most, then a button that opens the emoji picker for any other.

props.name: emoji
props.doc: The emoji offered, in order: the person's most used first.

props.name: more
props.doc: A last button opens the emoji picker, for an emoji not offered.

events.name: pick
events.doc: An emoji was picked: carries it.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.doc: A context menu of the view it stands in: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it. Its commands come first, as the view placed them; the system adds what the item offers that the view did not place and a typing field to filter them. A destructive command runs at once and is undone afterwards, never confirmed first.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The menu's content, in order: commands, separators and an emoji bar.

components.name: HoverToolbar
components.doc: Controls shown over the trailing edge of the view they stand in while it is hovered or holds focus: quick reactions, Reply. Tab reaches them from the view.

slots.name: content
slots.doc: The controls, in order: buttons, an emoji picker.

components.name: Swipe
components.doc: What swiping the view it stands in across does: it follows the finger, uncovers the command and runs it when let go past the threshold, or springs back.

slots.name: leading
slots.doc: What swiping from the leading edge towards the trailing edge does.

slots.name: trailing
slots.doc: What swiping from the trailing edge towards the leading edge does.

components.name: Suggestion
components.doc: One completion an [`Autocomplete`] offers.

props.name: value
props.doc: What taking it puts in the field.

props.name: label
props.doc: What its row says; the value unless said.

props.name: detail
props.doc: Dim text at its trailing end: a kind, a count.

props.name: subtitle
props.doc: A dim line under the label: a page's address under its title.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before it.

props.name: who
props.doc: The person it names, shown as their avatar.

components.name: BoardLane
components.doc: One lane of a board: a heading and its cards, in order.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the lane stands for: a column, a status.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the lane is called, as its heading.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many cards the lane holds, beside its heading.

props.name: action
props.doc: The label of the one action that adds to the lane, at its foot under the cards: "New card". Drawn there, not in the heading, so the lane has one add and it is where the cards end; a lane that gives a `foot` of its own says it there instead.

slots.name: cards
slots.doc: The cards, in order.

slots.name: foot
slots.doc: What stands at the lane's foot, under its cards: the entry that adds to the lane. It stays in reach while the cards scroll above it.

events.name: act
events.doc: The lane's action was pressed.

events.name: drop
events.doc: A card was dropped into the lane: carries the card and its place among the lane's other cards, from 0. A card that takes drops itself reports those that land just before it.

components.name: BoardCard
components.doc: One card of a lane: a summary of the resource it stands for, which a press opens. The card is its body: a row given as its body is shown as a card — the row paints the surface, wraps its title and stands its facts under it — so what the card says is written once, and the row is what assistive technology reads as the lane's item. The card itself is the container around it, with no role of its own.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card stands for: what a drop carries when it is the card dropped.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one.

slots.name: menu
slots.doc: The commands of its context menu: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What the card shows, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The card was pressed: open what it stands for.

events.name: drop
events.doc: Another card was dropped just before this one: carries that card.

components.name: BreadcrumbSegment
components.doc: One place of a path: what it is called, and going there.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the place is called: "Documents".

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the place is: going there opens it.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The place was pressed: go there.

components.name: CardGridCard
components.doc: One card of a grid: a summary of the resource it stands for, which a press opens.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card stands for: its stable key, and what pressing it reports.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the card is called, in its head; without one the body speaks for it.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things the card lists, as a count beside its title.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected one among its peers.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What the card shows, in order.

events.name: activate
events.doc: The card was pressed: open what it stands for.

components.name: MenuItem
components.doc: One command of a menu: what it shows, and what choosing it does.

props.name: label
props.doc: What choosing it does, in a word or two.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the label, for recognition; the label stays its name.

props.name: destructive
props.doc: It takes something away: drawn as destructive, and undone rather than confirmed.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether it is the one chosen now, in a menu of choices (a sort order).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: It cannot run now (a `require` of its action does not hold). It is listed all the same, drawn as unavailable, and says `reason`.

props.name: reason
props.doc: Why it cannot run now, in the person's words (`require`'s own): read with the row, and kept beside the label so a person sees what it waits on.

props.name: group
props.doc: The run of commands it stands in (`group: "Due"`), as the app names it: consecutive rows of one run fold into one row that opens them.

props.name: key
props.doc: The plain key that runs it while the window it belongs to has the keyboard, as the app's action declared it (`key: "e"`), shown at the row's trailing edge as the keyboard in use spells it.

events.name: choose
events.doc: It was chosen.

components.name: ConversationEntry
components.doc: One line of a conversation: who said it and when, what it says, and how far on its way it is.

props.name: item
props.doc: The message it stands for: its stable identity, what a caller anchors a scroll to, and what changes follow.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who said it, as the person reads names. Empty for one that knowingly continues the run above it.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was said: a divider marks the first line of each day, and the time shows beside an author's name and under your own line.

props.name: said
props.doc: What it says.

props.name: outgoing
props.doc: Your own line (on the right, with its delivery state under it) rather than the other person's (on the left, under their name).

props.name: delivery
props.doc: How far your own line is on its way.

components.name: DataTableColumn
components.doc: One column of a table: what it is called, how wide it is, and how its cells read.

props.name: header
props.doc: What the column is called, as its header, and the key its cells are held under in a row.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it is: as wide as its content, one share of the spare room, or `pixels` wide.

props.name: pixels
props.doc: Its width in pixels, when `width` is `fixed`.

props.name: kind
props.doc: How its cells read: prose unless said. Figures line up, and a numeric column sorts as numbers.

props.name: lines
props.doc: How many lines a cell's text wraps to before it is elided; the row grows to hold them.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: Whether pressing its header sorts the table by it.

props.name: priority
props.doc: Which columns give way first when the table is narrow: `0` never hides, higher numbers hide before lower ones.

props.name: absent
props.doc: What an empty cell reads as, dimmed.

components.name: DataTableCell
components.doc: One cell of a row: what its column reads in this row.

props.name: column
props.doc: The header of the column it stands under.

props.name: value
props.doc: What it reads: absent (dimmed) when not given.

components.name: DataTableRow
components.doc: One row of a table: the resource it stands for, and the cells its columns read in it.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the row stands for: its stable key, and what selecting or activating it reports.

slots.name: cells
slots.doc: The cells, in the order of the table's columns. A column with no cell reads as absent.

components.name: DragItem
components.doc: One item of a run: what it stands for, and the view drawn in its slot.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the item stands for: what a drop carries, and what a drag out of the run reports.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the item is called, for its ghost and for assistive technology.

props.name: group
props.doc: The part of the run it belongs to: a bar's leading group, its centre, its trailing group, or the room between two groups.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What it shows.

events.name: activate
events.doc: It was pressed and let go without moving: open what it stands for.

components.name: EnumOption
components.doc: One case an [`EnumField`] offers: its name, what it reads as, and how it reads.

props.name: name
props.doc: The case's own name, as the app declares it: what an edit writes back, never read out.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the case reads as, in a word or two: "High".

props.name: icon
props.doc: The glyph the case names, when it names one.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone the case reads in: what the chip is washed in.

components.name: SwipeAction
components.doc: What swiping a row across does: one command on its item, uncovered under the row as it moves.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it does, in a word or two.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The glyph the swipe uncovers: a bin for a destructive command and a check for another, unless said.

props.name: destructive
props.doc: It takes something away: drawn as destructive, and undone rather than confirmed.

events.name: swipe
events.doc: The swipe completed.

components.name: MapPin
components.doc: One pin of a map, as an instance gives it: its key, its place and the view it shows.

props.name: name
props.doc: What it is, for assistive technology.

props.name: x
props.doc: The canvas point of its top-leading corner, in canvas pixels.

props.name: y
props.doc: The canvas y of its top-leading corner, in canvas pixels.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide it stands, in canvas pixels.

props.name: height
props.doc: How tall it stands, in canvas pixels; without it, as tall as its view asks.

slots.name: body
slots.doc: What it shows.

components.name: MediaCard
components.doc: One card of a grid: the art (a cover, a thumbnail, a photo) with its title and up to two meta lines under it. A press opens what it stands for.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the card stands for: what a press opens. Without one it is a picture with a title, which does nothing when pressed.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the card is called, under its art. Without one it is art only (a photo).

props.name: picture
props.doc: Its art: a picture by its address, loaded as it arrives.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The icon of a kind of thing, on the neutral tile: a podcast, a folder. Without a picture the placeholder shows the title's initials.

props.name: meta
props.doc: One line under the title (an artist, a channel, an author). Give two for two lines.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: The shape of its art, `square` unless said.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected card.

events.name: activate
events.doc: It was pressed: open what it stands for.

components.name: NavSection
components.doc: A group of places under a heading in a navigation list: a category of channels, a folder of notebooks. A collapsible one folds away under its heading.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the places are, as the heading over them.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Whether its heading folds it away.

props.name: add
props.doc: The action that makes another of the places in the group ("New project"), drawn at the end of the heading and run when the person presses it.

slots.name: items
slots.doc: The places, in order.

components.name: NavItem
components.doc: One place in a navigation list.

props.name: key
props.doc: What names the place across changes: what selection reports.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the place is called.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Its glyph.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many things it holds: a quiet count in tertiary ink.

props.name: live
props.doc: How many things wait for attention (unread, mentions): the list's one filled badge, in the person's colour; zero shows nothing.

props.name: unread
props.doc: Something new waits behind the place: its label stands out at rest.

props.name: mentions
props.doc: How many things behind the place name the person (mentions): more specific than the place's unread count, so it takes the badge's place while there are any, as Slack's one badge counts what names you rather than everything new.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the place stands for, when it is one (a channel): the host says how much of it the person has not seen, in `live`, and lifts the label while anything is.

props.name: person
props.doc: The person the place stands for, when it is one (a direct conversation): their avatar in the icon's place, ringed in their presence colour, and their presence badge. The icon and the avatar never both show: the person takes the icon's place.

events.name: select
events.doc: The place was chosen: what choosing it does, beside the list's own `select`.

components.name: PictureOption
components.doc: One tile of a [`PictureChoice`]: its picture and its name.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the tile says under its picture, and its spoken name.

props.name: picture
props.doc: What the tile shows: the theme's own sample of a setting.

components.name: Fact
components.doc: One fact of a row of facts: its text, and a glyph before it.

props.name: text
props.doc: The fact, in a few words: "3 MB".

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before it, from the icon set.

props.name: priority
props.doc: How long it stays where the row is narrow: higher stays longer, and of equal ones the last gives way first.

components.name: KeyHint
components.doc: One hint of a strip: the keys of a chord and what pressing them does.

props.name: keys
props.doc: The keys of the chord, modifiers first: `["Ctrl", "S"]`.

props.name: label
props.doc: What pressing them does, in a word or two: "Save".

components.name: Property
components.doc: One fact of a property list: what it is, and its value.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the fact is: "Due", "Owner".

props.name: value
props.doc: The fact.

props.name: copyable
props.doc: A trailing action that copies the value.

components.name: TabItem
components.doc: One tab of a frame: the resource it shows, and what its pill says.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the tab shows: what choosing the pill reports, and which tab its close chip closes.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the pill says, from the resource's title.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph before the title, from the resource's type.

props.name: attention
props.doc: The frame is waiting for the person on this tab: a dot at the pill's trailing edge.

props.name: modified
props.doc: Its content has unsaved changes: the close chip stands as the mark.

props.name: busy
props.doc: The content is loading: the pill's leading glyph turns.

slots.name: presence
slots.doc: Who else has this resource open now, drawn on the pill: their faces, from the resource's lenses.

components.name: TabFace
components.doc:
One face on a tab: who is at the tab's resource now.
The strip draws their initials in their presence colour, the same faces a window bar's pills carry, so a person sees at a glance who else is in a frame with them.

props.name: who
props.doc: Who it is: a person or an agent.

props.name: name
props.doc: What the room calls them, when it differs from their name here.

components.name: Segment
components.doc: One choice of a [`ToggleGroup`] or a [`ViewTabs`]: what it says, and how it shows.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it says.

props.name: short
props.doc: What it shows when its full label does not fit its share: "Mon" for "Monday".

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph: before the label on a tab ([`ViewTabs`]), and instead of it on any other strip, named by the label either way.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Its keyboard shortcut, named in its tooltip: "B", "Shift+R".

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be chosen now.

components.name: ToolbarButton
components.doc: One command of a toolbar: pressing it does one thing, or opens its menu.

props.name: label
props.doc: What it does, in a word or two. A command with a glyph shows only the glyph, the label naming it to assistive technology, in its tooltip and in the More menu.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A glyph instead of the label.

props.name: toggled
props.doc: A command that is on or off (bold, a panel shown), and whether it is on: on, it stands lifted, and it is a checked row in the More menu.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Whether it can be pressed now. A command with nothing to do never can.

props.name: dot
props.doc: A dot at its corner: something new behind it.

props.name: priority
props.doc: How long it stays in the row where the window is narrow: higher stays longer, and of equal ones the last goes to the More menu first.

props.name: joined
props.doc: It goes with the command before it (zoom out, zoom in): the two go to the More menu together, never one alone.

slots.name: menu
slots.doc: The commands of a menu it opens instead of doing one thing: Sort, Insert, View.

events.name: press
events.doc: It was pressed (a click, Enter or Space, the More menu, an assistive technology).

components.name: ToolbarSeparator
components.doc: A hairline between groups of a toolbar's commands. It never stands at the start or the end of what is shown.

components.name: ToolbarSpacer
components.doc: The room left in a toolbar, between the commands before it and those after it, which it pushes to the far end.

components.name: TreeViewRow
components.doc: What one row of a tree shows besides its label: a leading glyph, the tone its title reads in, trailing text and what assistive technology says of it.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A leading glyph: the kind of thing it is. Beside a checkbox it stands after the box, so a checked-off task still says what it is.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tone its label reads in.

props.name: secondary
props.doc: Dim text after the label: what the row belongs to (a project, a folder).

props.name: trailing
props.doc: Trailing text: a count, a kind, a size.

props.name: progress
props.doc: How far the branch got while it is folded, just before the trailing text: a done count among its children ("2/5"). Its node's [`TreeViewNodeProps::progress`] says it where the row gives none. Shown only when the branch is closed.

props.name: checkbox
props.doc: A checkbox at the start of the row: a task's done state, a selection. A press on it asks the node's [`TreeViewNodeProps::check`] instead of selecting the row.

props.name: description
props.doc: What assistive technology says of the row after its label ("Folder", "View").

components.name: TreeViewNode
components.doc: One node of a tree: its label, the resource it stands for, and where it stands.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the node stands for: its stable key, what selecting or activating it reports, and what its children name as their parent.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the row is called.

props.name: parent
props.doc: The resource of the node it stands under; without one it is a top-level node.

props.name: above
props.doc: The node the view shows just over this one under the same parent: the place the actions offered on it take when one reads a place (`above`). None for a first child.

props.name: branch
props.doc: Whether it opens to show the nodes under it. A node with children says so unless it says otherwise.

props.name: progress
props.doc: How far the branch got while it is folded ("1/3"), which the owner counts of its own children: the same count names a list row and an outline node, so both say one thing. The row's own [`TreeViewRowProps::progress`] says it instead where the row gives one.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Whether it is the selected node.

slots.name: row
slots.doc: What the row shows besides its label.

slots.name: menu
slots.doc: The commands of its context menu: a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it, so every action a row has stays reachable without a drag.

events.name: drop
events.doc: A node was dropped just before this one, or moved here by the keyboard: carries the node that moved, so the owner places it before this one under the same parent.

events.name: into
events.doc: A node was dropped inside this one, at the end of its children, or indented here by the keyboard: carries the node that moved.

events.name: check
events.doc: This node's checkbox was pressed: the owner toggles what the box stands for.

components.name: ListItem
components.doc: One item of a virtual list: the resource its row shows, the row, and what the row offers on the item.

props.name: item
props.doc: The resource the row shows: what selecting or activating the row reports.

props.name: presence
props.doc: Who else is at the item now (a collaborator's or an agent's lens on it), shown on the row.

props.name: author
props.doc: Who wrote it, in a transcript: the list shows their avatar, their name and the time over each run of their consecutive messages, so the row holds only what they wrote.

props.name: time
props.doc: When it was written, in a transcript: the time beside its author's name, and a divider over the first message of each day.

props.name: group
props.doc: The group the row is in, as the platform reads it over the group's first row: a day for a date. Rows of one group stand together under its heading, in the order they come.

props.name: group_done
props.doc: The group's day is the day the item was done on, not the day it is due: it reads as the day it happened (`Yesterday`, `Sunday`, `Jun 21`), never as a day gone by, and in no tone of its own.

props.name: group_tone
props.doc: How the group's heading and its count read: left to the platform, it reads the tone the date the heading holds asks for (a day gone by is overdue), unless the view names one.

props.name: tail
props.doc: The row is one of the items done with: they stand after every group, under the list's tail title, closed until the person opens them.

props.name: above
props.doc: The item the view shows just over this one in its group: the place the actions offered on the row take when one reads a place (`above`). None for the first of a group.

props.name: removed
props.doc: The item was removed and the person has not seen it go: the row stands in for it, its title struck through, at the row's own height. The UI host places such rows.

props.name: parent
props.doc: The item this one is a subtask of: in a tree list (`tree`) the row stands indented under that item's row, with a disclosure that folds it away.

props.name: parent_title
props.doc: The title of the item it is under, for the row to say where it belongs while that item is no row of the list.

props.name: progress
props.doc: Its open subtasks of all of them, on the row's trailing edge: "1/3".

slots.name: menu
slots.doc: What the item offers on its context menu (a right-click, the Menu key or a long press opens it, and selects the row): each of its allowed actions, after the menu the row's view placed (`attached`) and without those that menu placed already, so every action stays reachable.

slots.name: swipe
slots.doc: What swiping the row from its trailing edge does, unless its view says (`attached`).

slots.name: attached
slots.doc: What the row's view attached to it (`ui.ContextMenu`, `ui.HoverToolbar`, `ui.Swipe` anywhere in the row's view): its own menu, first in the row's menu; a toolbar shown while the row is hovered or holds focus; a swipe either way.

slots.name: change
slots.doc: What someone else changed of the item that the person has not seen yet: the row shows it, in their colour, on its trailing edge. The UI host places it (task-legibility §3).

slots.name: row
slots.doc: The row: a `ui.ListRow`, or any view.

enums.name: Shape
enums.doc: One shape of a drawing, in fractions of its box.

cases.name: rect
cases.doc: A rectangle, rounded by `round` (a fraction of its shorter side).

cases.name: arc
cases.doc: An arc around (cx, cy), from `from` to `to` in fractions of a turn from the top.

cases.name: line
cases.doc: A line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

cases.name: path
cases.doc: A path through `points`, x and y in turn.

fields.name: smooth
fields.doc: A smooth curve rather than straight segments.
